description: Validerer suppliers-tabel, FK, indeks og kobling til Espresso.

assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'suppliers'
SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'products' AND column_name = 'supplier_id'

SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM information_schema.table_constraints WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'products' AND constraint_name = 'products_supplier_fk' AND constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY'
SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND indexname = 'ix_products_supplier'
SELECT p.name, s.name, s.city FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON s.id = p.supplier_id WHERE p.name = 'Espresso'
assertions.message: Espresso er koblet til Nordic Beans i Aarhus
